title.en: The Ant and the Cricket (from Aesop's fables)

text.en: One creature sang all summer; the other stored food for winter.

A silly young cricket, used to singing through the warm months, finds his cupboard empty when winter comes. There is not a crumb on the snow-covered ground and no flower or leaf. Starving, he goes to the ant, who has worked and stored food, to ask for help.
A fable is a traditional story that teaches a moral lesson, usually with animals as characters. This poem teaches the importance of hard work and planning for the future.
Learn the words cupboard, famine, starvation, fable and moral. Note the poem's lively rhyme and speech marks.
